messages:
maria (docs): quick thread — I opened a draft PR for a migration guide focused on the sample-app and edgecases for v1->v2. PR: https://repo.internal/redwood/docs/pull/495
ken (sdk): thanks. we need explicit before/after code snippets for the SDK rename (model(s) -> responses.create, input param rename). keep them copy-pastable.
sara (product): call out model swap fallback behavior. customers expect an alias fallback to a compatible variant when exact alias is absent. docs should show how to detect and plan for it.
aj (eng): runtime note: we'll accept v1 tokens for 90 days post-cut, but we return header `x-rw-deprecated: v1-legacy` on affected requests. include example curl showing the header.
luis (support): we've seen ~6 tickets where users hit "alias not found" and tried to call the old endpoint. please add a troubleshooting snippet with the exact error text we return.
maria (docs): added Troubleshooting section with errors and suggested fixes. snippet: ```
# v1 usage
client.generate({ model: "redwood/cheddar-v1", prompt: "..." })

# v2 usage
const resp = await client.responses.create({ model: "redwood/cheddar-v2", input: "..." })
```
ken (sdk): good. add aliasMap helper example: `await aliasMap.migrate(["redwood/cheddar-v1"])` plus batch embeddings param rename `input`->`texts`.
sara (product): also include a short rollback plan: detect the deprecation header, then route requests to `redwood/cheddar-compat` until migration is complete.
aj (eng): ops note: if you pin by sha, lock both alias and sha: `model: "redwood/cheddar@sha:abcdef"`. add to docs.
maria (docs): PR checklist in description: 1) validate SDK snippets with ken; 2) sample-app patch + smoke tests; 3) support FAQ template; 4) infra rollout window check.
luis (support): paste the FAQ template here so I can import it.
maria (docs): FAQ template: "If you see `error: alias not found` after sunset, check your client for param rename, verify alias in model catalog, run `aliasMap.migrate()` for bulk updates."
ken (sdk): will add migration helper + small test in our SDK PR. PR: https://repo.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/774
deploy-bot: docs-site:main -> staging scheduled at 2024-12-12T19:00:00Z
sara (product): wording note — public docs should avoid the term "breaking". use "sunset" and "required changes". internal notices can be clearer.
aj (eng): enabling telemetry header in prod at cut+7 days. include internal date.
maria (docs): sample-app patch link: https://repo.internal/redwood/samples/pull/215. local smoke passed.
luis (support): added KB entry pointing to sample-app and FAQ.
ken (sdk): CI green and I pushed the aliasMap helper change.
maria (docs): can folks review the docs PR by EOD PST? planning to publish public migration guide tomorrow AM unless objections.
sara (product): minor copy edits left, nothing blocking.
aj (eng): technical LGTM.
luis (support): OK from support.
ken (sdk): Approved.
maria (docs): merging in 10 min unless someone flags. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
